lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa leene kar apune upajee daras piaas ||
lines.translation: Granting His Grace, He has made me His Own. The thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan wells up within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g mil har gun gaae binasee duteeaa aas ||1||
lines.translation: Joining the Society of the Saints, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; I have given up other hopes. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਅਟਵੀ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਕਹਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa udiaan atavee te kaadhe maarag sa(n)t kahio ||
lines.translation: The Saint has pulled me out of the utterly desolate wilderness, and shown me the path.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਤ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਨੁ ਲਹਿਓ ॥੨॥੧੦੦॥੧੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: dekhat daras paap sabh naase har naanak ratan lahio ||2||100||123||
lines.translation: Gazing upon His Darshan, all sins are taken away; Nanak is blessed with the jewel of the Lord. ||2||100||123||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਅਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਖੋਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee ree ario prem kee khor ||
lines.translation: O mother, I am involved with the Love of the Lord;

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਰੁਚਿਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਕਤ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਤੋਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan ruchit piaas man su(n)dar sakat na koee tor ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am intoxicated with it. My mind has such a longing and thirst for the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of my Beauteous Lord. No one can break this. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਪਤਿ ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਧਨ ਮੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: praan maan pat pit sut ba(n)dhap har sarabas dhan mor ||
lines.translation: The Lord is my breath of life, honor, spouse, parent, child, relative, wealth - everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਅਸਤ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨਤ ਹੋਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dhrig sareer asat bisataa krim bin har jaanat hor ||1||
lines.translation: Cursed is this body of bones, this pile of maggots and manure, if it knows any other than the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਜੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaio kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan paraa poorabalaa jor ||
lines.translation: The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful to me, by the power of the karma of my past actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਆਨ ਨਿਹੋਰ ॥੨॥੧੦੧॥੧੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran kripaa nidh saagar binasio aan nihor ||2||101||124||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Treasure, the Ocean of Mercy; my subservience to others is past. ||2||101||124||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਕੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: neekee raam kee dhun soi ||
lines.translation: The Lord's melody is noble and sublime.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਪਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal anoop suaamee japat saadhoo hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lotus Feet of my Lord and Master are incomparably beautiful. Meditating on them, one becomes Holy. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵਤਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਲਮਲਾ ਕਢੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chitavataa gopaal darasan kalamalaa kadh dhoi ||
lines.translation: Just by thinking of the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Lord of the World, the dirty sins are washed away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਅੰਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਛਾਡੇ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran bikaar a(n)kur har kaat chhaade khoi ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord cuts down and weeds out the corruption of the cycle of birth and death. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paraa poorab jisahi likhiaa biralaa paae koi ||
lines.translation: How rare is that person who has such pre-ordained destiny, to find the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਣ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕਰਤੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਜੋਇ ॥੨॥੧੦੨॥੧੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: ravan gun gopaal karate naanakaa sach joi ||2||102||125||
lines.translation: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Creator, the Lord of the Universe - O Nanak, this is Truth. ||2||102||125||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke naam kee mat saar ||
lines.translation: The intellect of one who dwells on the Name of the Lord is excellent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਜੁ ਆਨ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਮਿਥਨ ਸਭ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bisaar j aan raachahi mithan sabh bisathaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who forgets the Lord and becomes involved with some other - all his showy pretensions are false. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮਿ ਭਜੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਾਪ ਹੋਵਤ ਖਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gam bhaj suaamee paap hovat khaar ||
lines.translation: Meditate, vibrate on our Lord and Master in the Company of the Holy, and your sins shall be eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਬਸਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: charanaarabi(n)d basaai hiradai bahur janam na maar ||1||
lines.translation: When the Lord's Lotus Feet abide within the heart, the mortal is never again caught in the cycle of death and birth. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar anugrah raakh leene ek naam adhaar ||
lines.translation: He showers us with His kindness and compassion; He saves and protects those who take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੦੩॥੧੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: din rain simarat sadaa naanak mukh oojal darabaar ||2||103||126||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on Him, day and night, O Nanak, your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||2||103||126||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੀ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanee too(n) raam kai dar maanee ||
lines.translation: Honored - you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਸਭ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g mil har gun gaae binasee sabh abhimaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; your egotistical pride will be totally dispelled. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaar anugrahu apunee kar leenee guramukh poor giaanee ||
lines.translation: Showering His kindness and compassion, He shall make you His Own. As Gurmukh, your spiritual wisdom shall be perfect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh aana(n)d ghanere thaakur daras dhiaanee ||1||
lines.translation: All peace and all sorts of ecstasy are obtained, by meditating on the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of my Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਰਤਨਿ ਸਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਸਾਈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nikat varatan saa sadaa suhaagan dah dis saaee jaanee ||
lines.translation: She who dwells close to her Lord is always the pure, happy soul-bride; she is famous in the ten directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੧੦੪॥੧੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: pri ra(n)g ra(n)g ratee naaraain naanak tis kurabaanee ||2||104||127||
lines.translation: She is imbued with the Love of her Loving Beloved Lord; Nanak is a sacrifice to her. ||2||104||127||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਅ ਚਰਨ ਆਸਰੋ ਈਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: tu charan aasaro ees ||
lines.translation: O Lord, I take the Support of Your Lotus Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪਛਾਨੂ ਸਾਕੁ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਤੁਮੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumahi pachhaanoo saak tumahi sa(n)g raakhanahaar tumai jagadees || rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are my Best Friend and Companion; I am with You. You are our Protector, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਹਮਰੋ ਹਮ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਕਹੀਐ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too hamaro ham tumare kaheeai it ut tum hee raakhe ||
lines.translation: You are mine, and I am Yours; here and hereafter, You are my Saving Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੋਈ ਲਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too bea(n)t apara(n)par suaamee gur kirapaa koee laakhai ||1||
lines.translation: You are Endess and Infinite, O my Lord and Master; by Guru's Grace, a few understand. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਕਨੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin bakane bin kahan kahaavan a(n)tarajaamee jaanai ||
lines.translation: Without being spoken, without being told, You know all, O Searcher of hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੇ ॥੨॥੧੦੫॥੧੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau mel lae prabh naanak se jan daragah maane ||2||105||128||
lines.translation: One whom God unites with Himself, O Nanak, that humble being is honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||105||128||
